note: OUT OF SCOPE for test-based detection, not an open defect. This mutation rewrites a TEST ASSERTION rather than production code, and no test can defend its own assertions from being rewritten — the synthetic membership cases prove the RULE (equality, not containment, with an unapproved extra rejected) but cannot stop someone editing the call that applies it. The production-side risk it points at — an exemption present but unapproved — IS covered by those synthetic cases.
